content.short: Regulated stablecoin and digital asset infrastructure for banks and fintechs, strongest in MENA.
content.description: Fuze provides the plumbing for businesses that want to offer crypto without building it themselves. Its products cover stablecoin orchestration across fiat rails, cross-border payments in 65 countries with round-the-clock settlement, a gateway for accepting 100 digital assets, and wealth and trading features. More than 400 institutions use it, processing around $10 billion a year.
content.meta: Fuze gives 400+ banks and fintechs regulated rails for stablecoin payments, crypto acceptance and trading in 65 countries.
